description: A team project run on AKOS: the brief, the backlog and its sprints, the RAID, who's who, the ceremonies and the weekly review, the team board, reporting, the tool and artifact registers and the onboarding guide. Every skill is the product manager's, in the project-management folder; the team updates its status on the board in Excel.
top: Project management: the registers, the records, the reports and the brief; every skill, for the product manager
The work itself: one folder per WBS row, WP.<WBS ID> <Title>, with its discovery, specification, plan and notes
Reference material for the whole team
Editor workspaces, one per profile: the team's opens the project; the product manager's adds the project-management folder, where the skills load
folders: The tool register: every tool the project runs on, and each tool's TD
The backlog: every piece of work, the sprint calendar, and each sprint's team board
Risks, actions, issues and decisions, each with an owner and a date to look again
The sprint records the ceremonies write
What is sent: status reports as sent, announcements, minutes
The status reports and sprint updates, generated from the records
The project's guide for its team and for outsiders, generated from its own files
Restricted to the product manager and whoever they name, in SharePoint; kept out of git
The stakeholder register, the communications plan and the contacts
steps: the stakeholder register, in the confidential folder
documents: Why the project exists, its outcome and done-when, what would make it stop, and how it is measured
next: Set up who's who, and who receives what.
